visual_hook_intense_zoom.description: An aggressive, fast zoom into the subject to reset visual attention. Creates an immediate orienting response.
visual_hook_intense_zoom.best_for: The beginning of a new scene, or when emphasizing a critical piece of data.

ltx_params_injection.prompt_injection: Intense, rapid zoom into the subject.

visual_hook_pan_whip.description: A rapid, blurred whip-pan transition that forces the eye to track movement, breaking static habituation.
visual_hook_pan_whip.best_for: Transitioning between two contrasting concepts or locations.

ltx_params_injection.prompt_injection: Rapid whip-pan transition blurring the background.

kinetic_typography_flash.description: 1 to 3 critical words flash maximally large in the center of the screen, perfectly timed to the audio. Anchors the eye to the center of the frame.
kinetic_typography_flash.best_for: Keywords, statistics, or the main thesis statement of the scene.
kinetic_typography_flash.assembly_instructions: Identify the 1-3 target words in the WhisperX timestamp data. Create an overlay text clip exactly matching those start/end times. Font size: maximum. Alignment: center-center.

auditory_hook_sub_bass_impact.description: A deep, low-frequency sound effect (SFX) impact that occurs simultaneously with a visual hook. Provides cross-modal sensory alignment.
auditory_hook_sub_bass_impact.best_for: Accompanying kinetic typography flashes or the start of a visually intense scene.
auditory_hook_sub_bass_impact.assembly_instructions: Insert sub-bass SFX clip into track A2_Music perfectly aligned with the start timestamp of the target visual.

pacing_rule_45s_limit.description: No single scene should exceed 45 seconds of contiguous narration. Focus decays rapidly beyond this point without a thematic context shift.
pacing_rule_45s_limit.evaluation_instructions: If a scene exceeds 45 seconds, the scenario agent must split the scene into two distinct scenes with contrasting visual themes.

pacing_rule_tri_voice.description: Utilize three distinct voice personas per scene (e.g., authoritative narrator, experiential voice, didactic explainer) to prevent auditory habituation.
pacing_rule_tri_voice.best_for: Assigning TTS voices during the audio generation phase.
pacing_rule_tri_voice.evaluation_instructions: Ensure Qwen3-TTS speaker tags cycle between at least three distinct voice profiles within any contiguous 60-second block.
